label: configures property
type: the subject provisioning mechanism (an API surface like sgw:admin-rest-api, or a configuration method like sgw:legacy-pre-3-config) is stated to set or update the object property/setting. Distinct from configurableVia/configuredVia (a setting's OWN record naming what can configure it) - this predicate is filed from the mechanism's side, naming what it reaches.
